original_claim.evidence: Exact C05:200 ACIP row: ,BRDZUN DU SMRA BA'I NI, ZHING LAS DANG GRU SPYOD PA'I LAS KYI MTHA' RGYAS PAR MI 'GYUR BA DANG MTHUN PAR MI 'GYUR ZHING PHAL CHER BSLU BA DANG 'JIGS PA DANG 'JIGS SU RUNG BA'I RGYU MANG PO DANG LDAN PA DANG ,. Its wylie has gru spyod and GMR's English has ‘work in cooperation with other people’. Current HGM evidence gives GRU/gru = ‘ship’ and GROGS/grogs = ‘friend’, ‘companion’, ‘associate’; neither GRU SPYOD nor GROGS SPYOD is an HGM glossary compound. Exact same-passage rows C09:157, C16:778, and C17:504 all preserve GRU SPYOD and identical English, so textual identity does not establish independent publication or a local ingestion defect. A corpus search found no GROGS SPYOD row. The candidate is not one of the registered converter, footnote, folio, heading-glue, running-head, or 1,500-character classes. The semantic fit supports the correction but the available digital witnesses cannot prove it.
